Sylas

the Unshackled
Mid laneJungle laneTop laneSupport lane

Sylas is a chain-swinging battle mage who dives into fights, heals off his enemies and steals their ultimates. He wins long, messy skirmishes rather than clean one-shots, and the better the enemy team's ultimates are, the stronger he gets. Pick him if you like brawling up close and outplaying people with their own tools.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Sylas

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Better as a counter-pick. Long-range mages poke him out, but into melee champions and big ultimates he's great.

Pick into

  • Teams with powerful teamfight ultimates you can steal, like Malphite, Amumu or Orianna
  • Short-range or melee mids he can out-sustain, like Fizz or Irelia
  • Teams without much anti-heal or point-and-click crowd control
  • Compositions that want messy, close-range skirmishes

Avoid into

  • Long-range poke mages who kite him, like Taliyah and Hwei
  • Drain-tanks with anti-heal or more sustain, like Swain
  • Teams with lots of point-and-click crowd control that stops his dives

Great teammates

Jarvan IVJarvan IV's engage traps enemies so Sylas can dive in and finish them.
LeonaLeona's crowd control sets up Sylas's chains and keeps targets still for his combo.
OrnnA tanky frontline that starts fights, letting Sylas follow up instead of diving first.

Your team needs: Pick Sylas when your team has a frontline to start fights and the enemy has big ultimates worth stealing.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Hijack lets you use the enemy's best ultimate against them, so he's strong into teams with big teamfight ultimates
  • Kingslayer heals you more the lower your health is, so he wins drawn-out fights
  • Two-part Abscond / Abduct gives you an engage and an escape in one ability
  • Petricite Burst after every spell gives strong area damage for wave clear and fights

Weaknesses

  • Short range: long-range mages can poke him out of lane before he gets in
  • His power is in his combo; if Abduct (E2) misses, his engage is much weaker
  • Point-and-click crowd control stops his dives cold
  • Anti-heal (Grievous Wounds) cuts down the healing he relies on

Power spikes

  • Level 3: all three basic spells; your E-Q-W combo with autos wins many short trades
  • Level 6: Hijack. Steal your laner's ultimate for a kill threat, or keep looking for roams
  • First item (Hextech Rocketbelt): an extra dash and burst; 26.20 made its active hit harder but gave less ability haste
  • Two items (Riftmaker): you become a real frontline brawler who heals through fights
  • Three items (Zhonya's Hourglass): dive the backline, then stasis while your team follows up

Top tips

  • Always auto-attack between spells: Petricite Burst is a big part of your damage
  • Save Kingslayer (W) for when you're low: it heals more at low health
  • Look at the enemy ultimates in the loading screen and plan which one you want to steal
  • Dash with E first to find an angle around the minion wave, then throw Abduct
  • You can't steal the same champion's ultimate again for a while, so pick your target wisely
  • Buy Zhonya's Hourglass third (or earlier) against assassins who burst you after you dive
  • Hijacked ultimates use your ability power, so stolen damage ultimates get scary as you build
